options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path to the SAPCAR binary, for example, C(/home/dummy/sapcar) or C(https://myserver/SAPCAR). If this parameter is not provided, the module will look in C(PATH).

options.name: dest
options.description: The destination where SAPCAR extracts the SAR file. Missing folders will be created. If this parameter is not provided, it will unpack in the same folder as the SAR file.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: If C(true), existing files will be overwritten during extraction. B(This should be used with caution!) If C(false), the module checks if the expected file names are already present in the destination folder and only extracts if they are not found. It does not remove files, but overwrites them if they are already present in the destination folder.

options.name: path
options.description: The path to the SAR/CAR file.

options.name: remove
options.description: If C(true), the SAR/CAR file will be removed. B(This should be used with caution!)

options.name: security_library
options.description: The path to the security library, for example, C(/usr/sap/hostctrl/exe/libsapcrytp.so), for signature operations.

options.name: signature
options.description: If C(true), the signature will be extracted.
